definitions.providerDiscovery: A city with a successful provider query, stable native identities, an independent exact-ID reread and retained ID-only parcel sample; discovery is not production admission.
definitions.awaitingFirstQualification: Unique positive UN city identities across web, provider and qualification records, excluding production cities and all cities already attempted by qualification.
definitions.held: Previously attempted qualification requiring data-source fixes, adapter work or reliable provider access; excludes the five adapter cities admitted in this release.
